description: Execution guardrails for the EDI Openflow Parser plugin

prohibited_patterns.reason: Landing tables must follow the typed schema pattern in config/edi_format_specs.yaml

prohibited_patterns.pattern: Direct field_maps.py modification without config update
prohibited_patterns.reason: All format definitions flow from edi_format_specs.yaml → generated code
Always use hatch-datavolo-nar for NAR builds
Use PutSnowpipeStreaming v1 (Record Reader + Table target) for this architecture
SPCS IP changes require explicit user approval — can lock out accounts

quality_gates.G1: Snowflake connection verified, target database exists or user approves creation
quality_gates.G2: User has local clone/fork of backbone repo or creates one
quality_gates.G3: Transaction format spec is parseable (from config, user description, or implementation guide)
quality_gates.G4: Generated field map validates against sample data (if provided)

output_modes.write: Default. Writes generated files directly to user's workspace.
output_modes.dry_run: Output-only. Presents code blocks for user to apply manually. Activated by user preference or when no repo is detected.
